clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar’s Cleft of Shadow, Kor'ghan watches over remedies and toxins. The Darkspear troll stands outside Rekkul's Poisons and seeks help preparing antidotes for Durotar’s venomous predators.

Kor'ghan keeps watch over remedies and toxins outside Rekkul's Poisons in Orgrimmar’s Cleft of Shadow. From the capital, he sends travelers into Durotar’s red canyons to gather venomous components from scorpids. He needs them to prepare antidotes for the dangers of the wilderness.
